title: Dope – Ice Cool
description:
DOPE Ice Cool Strong delivers the classic mint flavor in a slimmed nicotine pouch with 16mg/g of nicotine strength.

DOPE Ice Cool offers you 22 all white pouches packed with cooling mint flavour in a slimmed format that sits very comfortable under your lip. The pouches are semi-dry which makes for a perfect release of both flavor and nicotine. Since they are all white, you won’t have to worry about staining your teeth!

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,2

- Content: 15,4g

- Format: Slim

- Portions/Can: 22
